preconditions.description: The input string length is between 1 and 1000 characters.

postconditions.expression: output == sum(1 for i in range(len(input)) for j in range(i, len(input)) if input[i:j+1] == input[i:j+1][::-1])
postconditions.description: The output is the total number of palindromic substrings in the input string.
